results.title: AI Tools Have Full Admin Access to Your Shopify Store
results.snippet: We audited the API permissions of AI and automation tools across 9 D2C brands. 73% had at least one third-party app with full Shopify admin API access — meaning read/write to customers, orders, payments, and inventory.

results.title: API terms compliance
results.snippet: There may be cases where you can't update some orders due to Shopify restrictions. In such cases, try to sync the data. However, if Shopify blocks you, then you don't need to sync. You'll need to import orders created from a Shopify product listing on a third-party platform using the orderCreate mutation.

results.title: Shopify Help Center | Connecting your Shopify store to AI tools
results.snippet: After you authorize sharing your data with the third party, the data that you selected is passed to the AI tool. At that point, your data leaves the Shopify environment and is governed by that provider's terms and privacy policy. Review each permission before you confirm it, because you can't decrease the data access scope after you approve it without uninstalling the app entirely. You can revoke access at any time by uninstalling the app or connector from your admin settings.
